title: Open-data catalogue for the App
rules: Open licences only; status 'verify' or 'unknown' means no import into git until a person records the licence text
Unknown stays UNKNOWN; accessibility is never inferred
Large outputs go to release assets or chunked files, never into git
Counts are record counts, not coverage claims or verified facts

totals.excludedFromTotal: StatCan datapoints (118,764), OSM building footprints (3,128,244), Wikidata items without P2846 (85,284), and not-counted sources

sources.name: OpenStreetMap Ontario: objects with accessibility tags

licence.name: Open Database License 1.0

sources.shareAlike: ODbL share-alike: any public derived database built from OSM (including tiles' underlying data) must be offered under ODbL; keep OSM-derived records in their own partition with attribution; produced works (rendered maps) need attribution only.

counted.method: pyosmium 4 KeyFilter stream over ontario-261114.osm.pbf (1,017,668,533 bytes, Last-Modified 2026-11-15 05:34 UTC); object counted once if it has any of wheelchair, toilets:wheelchair, kerb, tactile_paving, ramp:wheelchair, highway=elevator, parking_space=disabled, capacity:disabled, automatic_door. File deleted after counting.

sources.accessibilityFields: wheelchair, toilets:wheelchair, entrance, kerb, tactile_paving, step_count, ramp:wheelchair, parking_space=disabled, capacity:disabled, highway=elevator, automatic_door
sources.coveredBy: access-maps #1 (cursor/ontario-open-data-pipeline-986f) already imports OSM Ontario venues, washrooms and paths. No new lane.
sources.importPlan: Covered by access-maps #1. Do not re-import in access-tools. Values other than yes/no/limited/designated (for example wheelchair=2, bad, ramp) stay UNKNOWN and are listed as unmapped.
